answer:
Use the OpenFOAM solver icoFoam.
The domain is a two-dimensional square cavity with side length 0.1 m, spanning x from 0 to 0.1 m and y from 0 to 0.1 m.
Discretize the domain with a uniform 20 by 20 orthogonal mesh.
Use kinematic viscosity nu = 0.001 m^2/s for the incompressible fluid.
The Reynolds number is 100, based on lid velocity 1 m/s, cavity length 0.1 m, and kinematic viscosity 0.001 m^2/s.
Set the initial velocity field in the interior to zero and the initial pressure field to zero.
Apply the top wall at y = 0.1 m as a moving wall with velocity (1 0 0) m/s, moving to the right.
Apply the bottom wall and both side walls as stationary no-slip walls with velocity (0 0 0) m/s.
Apply zero-normal-gradient pressure boundary conditions on all walls.
Set startTime to 0 s.
Set endTime to 0.5 s.
Set deltaT to 0.002 s.
Use writeControl = timeStep and writeInterval = 20 so results are written every 20 time steps.
Run a total of 250 time steps until the simulation reaches t = 0.5 s.
